+title: Test the error paths of ExecutorPromptCacheFile write, rename, remove and TokenLedger
+---
+## What
+
+File: `Libraries/MLXFoundationModels/ExecutorPromptCacheFile.swift`. File coverage: 94.07% (127/135 lines).
+
+Uncovered functions and ranges:
+- `ExecutorPromptCacheFile.write(_:to:)`, lines 110-119: 8/10. Uncovered 116-117. A failed write must remove the partial file `<name>.partial.safetensors` and throw.
+- `ExecutorPromptCacheFile.rename(_:to:)`, lines 193-199: 6/7. Uncovered 197. A failed rename throws a `POSIXError`.
+- `ExecutorPromptCacheFile.removeFile(at:)`, lines 209-219: 8/11. Uncovered 211 (no file at the URL) and 216-217 (a removal that fails goes to the log and does not throw).
+- `TokenLedger.encode(_:)`, lines 236-244: 8/9. Uncovered 239. A token that does not fit in Int32 throws `ExecutorPromptCacheFileError.tokenOutOfRange`.
+- `TokenLedger.decode(_:key:)`, lines 254-267: 13/14. Uncovered 258. A missing key, text that is not base64, or a byte count that is not a multiple of 4 throws `ExecutorPromptCacheFileError.ledgerNotDecodable(key)`.
+
+What to test:
+- `prepare` of an entry whose ledger holds `Int(Int32.max) + 1` throws `.tokenOutOfRange`.
+- `read` of a file whose `tokens` or `renderTokens` metadata is missing, is not base64, or has 3 bytes throws `.ledgerNotDecodable` with the correct key. Make the file with `savePromptCache` and the correct `format`, `modelID` and `sessionID` metadata.
+- `write` to a URL whose folder does not exist throws, and leaves no partial file.
+- `write` to a destination that is a folder (so the rename fails) throws, and removes the partial file.
+- `removeFile(at:)` of a missing URL does nothing and does not throw.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] Each uncovered line above is covered by a test.
+- [ ] Each error test checks the exact error case, not only `(any Error).self`.
+- [ ] No test leaves a file in the temporary folder.
+- [ ] All five unit bundles pass.
+
+## Tests
+
+Test file: `Tests/MLXFoundationModelsTests/ExecutorPromptCacheFileTests.swift`.
+
+Run:
+
+```sh
+swift build --build-tests
+xcrun xctest .build/out/Products/Debug/MLXFoundationModelsTests.xctest
+```
+
+## Workflow
+
+- Use `/tdd` #coverage-gap #prompt-cache
\ No newline at end of file
